task_title: 큰 결과의 chunked/lazy read가 필요하면 HDF5 또는 Zarr 중 요구에 맞는 한 구현을 우선 채택한다

physics_configuration.format_decision: HDF5 through h5py (BSD-3-Clause, one binary wheel, native complex compound type, one file per result), declared as the optional extra torchfdtd[hdf5]; Zarr was not implemented because it would add zarr and numcodecs and spread a result over a directory tree. h5py 3.16.0 was present in the interpreter's user site-packages (installed for another package), not in the project venv.
physics_configuration.round_trip_run: tests/test_result_store.py::plane_project: 2D, 2.4 x 2 um at 0.1 um (24 x 20 x 1 cells), 3 PML cells, 60 steps, snapshot every 20 steps, one dielectric slab 0.4 x 2 um at x = 0.5 um, a point source at x = -0.6 um (wavelength 1 um, 1 cycle), a point Ez monitor at x = 0.2 um and an x-normal frequency plane at x = 0.8 um, 1 x 1 um, recording Ez and Hy, the x Poynting density and flux; CPU float32
physics_configuration.endpoint_run: demo_project('pmc'): closed PMC cavity, 3D 3.2 um cube at 0.2 um (16 x 16 x 16 cells), 160 steps, exact endpoints, so endpoint_fields E_upper and H_upper exist
physics_configuration.synthetic_volume: the E dataset of the round-trip file replaced by a chunked (512, 512, 512, 3) float32 dataset, 1,610,612,736 bytes nominal, chunks (1, 512, 512, 1), with one x plane (index 100, component Ez) written from a seeded standard normal (numpy default_rng(7)); every other chunk is unwritten and therefore not stored
physics_configuration.reads_measured: Result.open(path).field_slice('E', 'Ez', 'x', 100) (one stored chunk) and field_slice('E', 'Ez', 'y', 200) (a plane crossing all 512 x chunks, 511 of them unallocated)
physics_configuration.layout: torchfdtd/result_store.py layout 1: root attributes project, summary, units, field_monitors, monitor_spectra; datasets mesh/{x,y,z}_um, frames, frame_steps, epsilon, signals, times, E, H, monitors/<k>/{frequency_hz,spectrum}, field_monitors/<k>/<array>, endpoint/<name>

reference_method: the in-memory Result of the same run: every array must be equal after Result.save(format='hdf5') and Result.open(path).load() or Result.load(path), with the same dtype and shape; chunk shapes are read back from the file with h5py; process memory is read with psutil.Process().memory_info() (rss and, on Windows, peak_wset) immediately before opening the file and immediately after the two plane reads, after gc.collect()

observables.name: array_round_trip
observables.definition: numpy array equality with dtype and shape equality for frames, frame_steps, epsilon, signals, times, E, H, every plane array (fields, poynting, points_um, weights, frequency_hz, flux) and endpoint fields; project model_dump equality; summary and plane metadata equality after a JSON round trip

observables.name: coordinate_and_unit_metadata
observables.definition: mesh/{x,y,z}_um equal Region.mesh_nodes with attribute units = 'um'; times carries units = 's'; the root units attribute equals summary['units']; field_units and flux_units of every plane are restored

observables.name: spectrum_recomputation
observables.definition: Result.spectra recomputed from the restored signals against the original spectra

observables.name: lazy_slice_equality
observables.definition: frame(i), field_slice(field, component, axis, index), signal(k), monitor_spectrum(k), PlaneFile.fields(f, component) and PlaneFile.plane(f, component) equal the corresponding slices of the in-memory arrays

observables.name: chunk_shapes
observables.definition: E and H chunks (1, ny, nz, 1); frames (1, a, b); plane fields (1, points, 1); signals (steps, 1)

observables.name: stored_file_bytes
observables.definition: size of the synthetic file on disk divided by the nominal volume bytes

observables.name: rss_growth_fraction
observables.definition: (rss after the two plane reads - rss before opening) / 1,610,612,736

acceptance_limits.rss_growth_fraction: < 0.05 (80.5 MB of the 1.61 GB nominal volume); the read itself needs 1 MiB per plane plus the 1 MiB h5py chunk cache
acceptance_limits.npz_path: Result.save(path) with a .npz suffix or format='npz' still writes the layout of COMPATIBILITY.md and Result.load reads it; format='npz' keeps numpy's rule of appending .npz to another suffix
acceptance_limits.refusals: a file without the format attribute and a file with layout 2 raise ValueError naming the file and the layout
acceptance_limits.source_of_limits: COMPLETION_PROGRAM_KO.md G8-02 asks that a partial read not load the full volume; the 5% budget is this case's own declaration, fixed before the run, chosen as an order of magnitude above the expected 2 to 10 MB of chunk cache, output arrays and allocator noise

applicable_scope: HDF5 result files written by Result.save on the CPU resident solver (2D plane-monitor run and the 3D PMC endpoint run); lazy reads through Result.open; memory measured with psutil on Windows 11 with h5py 3.16.0 from the interpreter's user site-packages; NPZ, streamed, tensor and mode-network results are outside
verification_reason: no failures or errors, and no required test skipped or absent

null_reasons.package_or_wheel_sha256: no distribution file was supplied; the evidence applies to the source tree at source_commit
